stem.text: Two masses, $M$ and $m$, are connected by an inextensible string which passes over a frictionless pulley. Mass $M$ rests on a frictionless slope, as shown.

stem.alt: Pulley at the top of a slope. A mass labelled m hangs vertically from one side of the string; a mass labelled M rests on the slope. Angle theta is marked at the base of the slope, which is labelled frictionless slope.

stem.text: The slope is at an angle $\theta$ to the horizontal.
The two masses are initially held stationary and then released. Mass $M$ moves down the slope.
